test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) IG-EJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b359d3dc4071961d56752ceddfffa6aa0c386bfe003ea80adb706cb9b941c8c.png] 

Option 2) RP-NS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7c1e1adaa07291f37cf7c20fd12faf8a7c293b86ac406221dba92921ab6c102.png] 

Option 3) OM-KP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc7c95b05ea2dde69fbd38018f1289a29dc98b0d9e34117b9f3ce445ba26bad0.png] 

Option 4) MK-IO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea0e8742f7f9789c6b760f885b54c517fdfe7401927f91ceaa9215a0964f44e3.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'MK-IO' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
